title: Member Services Policy: Patronage Years and the PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Carried-In Credit Reserve
content:
**Section 1. Reduction for long patronage.** For a credit balance carried into PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), where the member's capital credit records carry distribution-margin allocations (one is booked for each patronage year) for at least 25 patronage years, the reserve days are reduced by 6; where they carry such allocations for at least 10 but fewer than 25 patronage years, the reserve days are reduced by 3; with fewer patronage years the reserve days are not reduced.

**Section 2. Records read.** The patronage years are counted from the member's Capital Credits (Patronage Capital) records: each distribution-margin allocation booked to the member counts as one patronage year. Allocations from any other source do not count toward the patronage years.

**Section 3. Floor.** The increases and reductions of the reserve days are applied together to the calendar days, after which the reserve days are never fewer than zero.

### Bands

| Patronage years with a distribution-margin allocation | Reserve days |
|---|---|
| 25 or more | reduced by 6 |
| 10 to 24 | reduced by 3 |
| 9 or fewer | not reduced |

### Hypothetical members

- A member whose records carry 31 distribution-margin allocations: reduced by 6.
- Exactly 25: reduced by 6. Exactly 24: reduced by 3.
- Exactly 10: reduced by 3. Exactly 9: not reduced.
- A member with 28 patronage years whose reserve days, before this reduction, come to 4: 4 reduced by 6 would fall below zero, so the reserve days are 0.
